messages.author: 6f81c58ba9ed02c3
messages.subject: Re: Longitudinal measurement invariance
parts:
Have you tried using the measEq.syntax function from semTools? It will generate lavaan code for measurement models with various levels of constraints placed on them so that the user can compare the models to see if measurement invariance is plausible.  https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/semTools/semTools.pdf

messages.subject: Re: Longitudinal measurement invariance
parts:
Hi Ryan,

I did measEq.syntax for my analysis. I want to use assess the measurement invariance of a 8-item depression scale for 4 waves.

The main issues so far I have is getting this warning message multiple times on some groups. I don't think that I made any misspecification in my model. I read some responses and it seems that the either the two items are highly correlated and redundant and one should dropped. I collapsed many variables too but it did not solve the issue. Any help on how to address this error message would be helpful.

Best, Hervet
